name: Telluride Town Park Campground
evidence: Esri z19 at 37.9350,-107.8048, 5 transects read off a metric grid: San Miguel 7-10 m of open water (NHD thin polygon ~10 m), under the 30 m rule. Town 2025 per-site map: premium 30-ft sites 3-5, 7-8 back the river; a parked rig there ~15-20 m from channel through thin riparian (partial canopy; site numbers matched by map layout). Town says no per-site photos.

name: Rio Grande Campground (Creede)
evidence: Esri z19, 6 transects read off a metric grid, 37.7620-37.7642: Rio Grande 25-36 m wet, NHD double-line polygon 33-39 m: river-size, near the line. South camp (toilet, parked rig, 37.7622,-107.0118) ~25-40 m from bed edge over open scrub, no road; middle pads have FSR 529 between. Pads inferred, no site map. Catalog: no lengths or photos; 33-ft Class A reported (Campendium 2020).

name: Ponderosa Campground (Antonito)
evidence: Esri z19 at 37.1212-37.1228,-106.329, pixel transects: Conejos mostly 27-32 m along the sites, 36 m north (18.8 and 22.5 m beside island/shade; runs merged with shadow discarded); NHD double-line ~28-35 m: at the line. Rigs 7-11 m ~8-15 m from bank over open unused lawn. Operator site refused (406): rates, seasonal rows, photos unread this pass.

name: Cayton Campground
evidence: Esri z19 at 37.7711,-107.9802 and 37.7722,-107.9772, 4 transects: Dolores 5-10 m wide; NHD single-line, well under 30 m. rec.gov 233250 tags all Loop A 'Riverfront' (spurs 30-70 ft, all fit); top-row pads ~10-20 m from channel through thin conifers. All 11 Loop A photos viewed (8 sites have none): no water shown, so no view value beyond the flags.
